scripts.build: npm run gen:mod && npm run build:core && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/mod/test/*.test.ts services/server/test/*.test.ts
scripts.server: npm run build:core && node --import tsx services/server/src/index.ts serve
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron apps/desktop/dist/main.cjs
scripts.demo: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE CCUSAGE_DEMO_DIR=demo-data electron apps/desktop/dist/main.cjs
scripts.dist:server: npm run build:core && npm run build:server && node scripts/build-server-package.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/build-desktop-packages.mjs --platform=all && node scripts/build-server-package.mjs
